---
title: "WES-Based HRD Analysis Using FACETS and scarHRD"
author: "Rahul Kumar"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
---

## Objective

Calculate WES-derived genomic scar measures-including HRD-LOH, telomeric allelic imbalance, large-scale state transitions and HRD-sum from FACETS allele-specific copy-number results.

##  Collapsed thousands of gene-level rows into unique FACETS segments.
# Kept autosomes 1-22.
# Removed segments with missing total copy number.
# Removed segments with missing minor-allele copy number.
# Removed invalid segments.

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(copynumber)
    library(sequenza)
    library(scarHRD)
})

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
    echo = TRUE,
    message = TRUE,
    warning = TRUE
)
```

```{r}

# Input and output directories
facets_dir <- paste0(
    "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/",
    "Downstream/FACETS/Result"
)

output_dir <- paste0(
    "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/",
    "Downstream/HRDetect"
)

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

output_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    "pILC_16samples_HRDresults.csv"
)

# Find FACETS files
facets_files <- list.files(
    facets_dir,
    pattern = "\\.gene_level\\.txt$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
)

cat("FACETS files found:", length(facets_files), "\n")

if (length(facets_files) == 0) {
    stop("No FACETS gene-level files found.")
}

all_results <- list()

for (facets_file in facets_files) {

    sample_id <- sub(
        "\\.gene_level\\.txt$",
        "",
        basename(facets_file)
    )

    cat("Processing:", sample_id, "\n")

    # Read FACETS gene-level file
    gene <- read.delim(
        facets_file,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        check.names = FALSE
    )

    # Collapse repeated genes to unique FACETS segments
    segments <- unique(
        gene[, c(
            "chrom",
            "seg",
            "seg_start",
            "seg_end",
            "tcn",
            "lcn"
        )]
    )

    # Keep valid autosomal allele-specific segments
    segments <- segments[
        segments$chrom %in% 1:22 &
        !is.na(segments$seg_start) &
        !is.na(segments$seg_end) &
        !is.na(segments$tcn) &
        !is.na(segments$lcn) &
        segments$tcn >= 0 &
        segments$lcn >= 0 &
        segments$lcn <= segments$tcn,
    ]

    if (nrow(segments) == 0) {
        stop(sample_id, ": no valid FACETS segments.")
    }

    segments$segment_length <-
        segments$seg_end - segments$seg_start + 1

    # Estimate sample ploidy
    ploidy_estimate <- weighted.mean(
        segments$tcn,
        segments$segment_length
    )

    # Prepare eight-column scarHRD input
    minor_cn <- segments$lcn
    major_cn <- segments$tcn - segments$lcn

    scar_input <- data.frame(
        SampleID = sample_id,
        Chromosome = paste0("chr", segments$chrom),
        Start_position = segments$seg_start,
        End_position = segments$seg_end,
        total_cn = segments$tcn,
        A_cn = pmin(minor_cn, major_cn),
        B_cn = pmax(minor_cn, major_cn),
        ploidy = ploidy_estimate
    )

    # Sort segments
    scar_input <- scar_input[
        order(
            as.integer(sub("chr", "", scar_input$Chromosome)),
            scar_input$Start_position
        ),
    ]

    # Temporary input file required by scarHRD
    temp_input <- tempfile(
        pattern = paste0(sample_id, "_"),
        fileext = ".tsv"
    )

    write.table(
        scar_input,
        temp_input,
        sep = "\t",
        quote = FALSE,
        row.names = FALSE
    )

    # Calculate HRD scores
    score <- scarHRD::scar_score(
        seg = temp_input,
        reference = "grch38",
        seqz = FALSE,
        ploidy = ploidy_estimate
    )

    unlink(temp_input)

    score_df <- as.data.frame(
        score,
        check.names = FALSE
    )

    score_df$sample <- sample_id
    score_df$estimated_ploidy <- ploidy_estimate
    score_df$segments_used <- nrow(scar_input)

    score_df <- score_df[
        , c(
            "sample",
            "HRD",
            "Telomeric AI",
            "LST",
            "HRD-sum",
            "estimated_ploidy",
            "segments_used"
        )
    ]

    all_results[[sample_id]] <- score_df
}

# Combine all samples
combined_results <- do.call(
    rbind,
    all_results
)

rownames(combined_results) <- NULL

# Save one combined CSV
write.csv(
    combined_results,
    output_file,
    row.names = FALSE,
    quote = FALSE
)

cat("\nAnalysis completed.\n")
cat("Samples analyzed:", nrow(combined_results), "\n")
cat("Output saved:", output_file, "\n")
cat("File exists:", file.exists(output_file), "\n")

combined_results
```
